plan: A marksman with an eagle who blinds her target and knocks back those who attack her.
aSurveiller: Her E (Vault). She knocks you back and slows you as soon as you get close: plan several ways to reach her.
contrer: Plan two ways to reach her: her E knocks back the first.
Her Q blinds you: your attacks miss, use your spells.
When she flies (R), she is fragile up close.

sorts.P: Valor marks enemies; next attack empowered.
sorts.E: Vault that knocks back and slows.
sorts.R: Takes flight with Valor at high speed.

momentFort: Very strong from level 1 to 5. Also fearsome in the late game: at level 16 her R is maxed to catch isolated targets.
